plan.title: Forward Auction Auto Title for Same-Family Products

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Configure the event as an auction with the entire lot awarded to one vendor.
Select the forward auction template without entering a title.
Add the first product from the specified family.
Add the second product from the same family.
Set the first product's location so the automatic title can resolve its location suffix.
Set the second product to the same location required by the scenario.

args.label: Enter the title of this event

steps.note: Assert that the untouched title field automatically shows the expected forward-auction family and location title.
